outputs.explanation: Stacked bar/area chart showing median state frequencies across a continuum of contiguous Pol II ChIP-seq bins (n=5912 promoters). This functions like a binned line/area plot summarizing a continuous variable rather than a small set of discrete bars; overlaying thousands of individual promoter values per bin/state would be unreadable, similar to the line-plot exemption.

Single-molecule stack plot where each row is an individual DNA molecule (2952 molecules), i.e., the individual data points are directly displayed; the sidebar summarizes state frequencies derived from these visible individual molecules.
Same representation as panel A (stacked bar/area chart of median state frequencies across continuous ChIP-seq bins for mouse promoters, n=6122); binned continuous summary, exempt like a line plot.
Single-molecule stack plot (2871 molecules) where each row is an individual molecule, directly showing the underlying individual data points behind the summarized state frequencies.
Box plot showing PIC occupancy distribution with median, IQR and whiskers; box plots are exempt from requiring overlaid individual points.
Box plot showing Pol II occupancy distribution with median, IQR and whiskers; box plots are exempt from requiring overlaid individual points.
